name: @meldframe/web
description: Web client: renders the app layer state and carries out its effects.

scripts.lint: eslint . && for p in web-panels web-variables web-activity web-canvas web-input web-e2e web-tools web-tokens web-chrome web-shell web-feedback web-export web-transport; do (cd ../../packages/$p && eslint -c ../../apps/web/eslint.config.js .) || exit 1; done
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run ui-literals && npm run licences
